design: INDIVIDUAL 10: an imposing tall elder with narrow hips and very wide upper torso, grey-green old hide, long rear skull crest within Yautja anatomy and two pale healed brow scars. Silver scalp tendrils swept to one side held by a flat bronze clasp. A sleeveless charcoal robe with a heavy purple drape on only the left shoulder, wide hammered bronze torc and ivory hanging rank cords. Holds a closed heavy teal law codex under one arm; free hand laid over chest in formal greeting.
